newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania to hold tender for $300 mln of housing.
newsitem.headline: Romania to hold tender for $300 mln of housing.

text.p: The Romanian government will guarantee credits worth $300 million for a state-owned housing construction project, an official said on Wednesday.

"The government decided to resort to foreign lenders to finance building of social houses that will cover some 50 percent of the country's one million house deficit," Public Works Minister Marin Cristea said.
He said the government was looking for foreign building companies willing to apply for the 10-year credits and carry out the actual work.
"The ministry will probably issue the tender documents by October 15, so that the houses could be ready in the first quarter of 1998," Cristea said.
Romania is confronted with an increased demand for state housing with only 48,000 houses built this year and some 150,000 in the past five years. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
